name: Cayman Islands

income_tax.summary: No income, withholding, payroll or social security taxes on individuals. The only mandatory contribution is the national pension: 5% from the employee (matched by the employer) up to CI$87,000 of earnings, or 10% for the self-employed.
income_tax.self_employed_notes: National Pensions Act s.47: the self-employed must contribute 10% of earnings up to the year's maximum pensionable earnings to a pension plan. The Act's default maximum is CI$87,000, 'or such other amount as may be prescribed by Order'; no Order for 2026 was found. Mandatory health insurance (employer pays at least half of the premium) is not included because the employee share was not verified.
income_tax.local_tax_note: No income tax of any kind (PwC, reviewed 29 May 2026). Work-permit holders must also be covered by health insurance; that cost is not modelled.

regimes.name: Global Citizen Concierge Program (closed)
regimes.description: CLOSED. Remote-work certificate launched in October 2020 that let employees of non-Cayman employers live in the Cayman Islands for up to 24 months. The Immigration (Transition) (Global Citizen Exemption) Regulations stopped accepting applications on 31 October 2022 and expired on 30 November 2024 (Maples, 2021 amendment); the Tourism Minister said the programme was 'no longer available as of October 2022' (Caribbean Journal 2023). No relaunch was found, so it is listed for history only and not counted as an open route. The Cayman Islands has no income tax, so the certificate affected access only.
regimes.duration_note: Up to 24 months per Maples (Nov 2021). Currently not open to new applicants. Income threshold of USD 100,000 (USD 150,000 with a spouse) comes from search-result summaries of 2020-21 coverage, not from a page opened here.

costs.notes: CIREBA Rentals (the brokers' association site), all three pages read 2026-10-15: 34 of 39 listings carried a price; most are 3+ bedroom houses from CI$3,000 to 23,500. Seven Mile Beach condos are thinly represented, so the figures are indicative. RE/MAX Cayman's lease search returned no results.

residence_routes: No nomad route is currently open (GCCP closed in 2022). Employees need a work permit sponsored by a Cayman employer (not researched). Non-working residents can use the 25-year Residency Certificate for persons of independent means (CI$1,000,000 investment incl. CI$500,000 in developed real estate, and income of at least CI$120,000 a year without local employment; no right to work) or the Certificate of Permanent Residence (CI$2 million in real estate), per the earlier jurisdiction research in data/jurisdictions/CYM.json. EU, US and other citizens use the same routes. US citizens remain taxable in the US on worldwide income; Cayman has no tax to credit.
